family.description: Family members include OrfA protein, a multifunctional accessory protein found in Feline immunodeficiency virus (FIV), a lentivirus that causes AIDS in domestic cats [[cite:PUB00085284]]. Multiple potential functions have been ascribed to OrfA, including transactivation of viral protein expression [[cite:PUB00085285]], effects on virion formation and infectivity [[cite:PUB00085286]], host cell cycle arrest [[cite:PUB00085291]] and downregulation of cell surface expression of the primary FIV receptor, CD134 [[cite:PUB00085287]].
family.name: Vpr-like OrfA
